style_prefix: Celestial Art Nouveau illustration, one image from a single cohesive premium series for a luxury astrology app. Palette strictly limited to: deep midnight indigo (#0B0A2A) and ink-violet grounds; burnished gold leaf with warm highlights (gradients from #D4AF37 to pale champagne #F5E6A8); rose-copper accents (#C97B63); moonstone pearl lavender-white (#EDE6F7) for the brightest lights. Alphonse Mucha inspired ornament: sinuous whiplash curves, ornate filigree, arched halo roundels, stylised lilies and stars. Fine gold constellation line-work (thin lines joining small bright star points) woven through the design. Painterly rendering with gilded metallic sheen, delicate engraving-like linework, soft inner glow, subtle film grain, rich but restrained detail. Elegant, mystical, calm, adult and refined - not cartoonish, not cute, not neon, no photorealism. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no runes, no captions, no signature, no logo, no watermark, no border text anywhere in the image.
